name: Coffee Machine Production Line Solution
summary: Turnkey automated production line solutions for coffee machine manufacturers, covering heating component assembly, water pump installation, and final inspection and packaging.
contentHtml:
The coffee machine production line solution is a turnkey automated solution provided by TXAM for coffee machine manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The full line covers the entire process, including heating component assembly, water pump installation, water circuit sealing, temperature control system installation, appearance finishing, functional testing, air tightness testing, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Precision assembly of heating components ensures heating efficiency
  • Automated water pump installation with precise and reliable positioning
  • Water circuit sealing system ensures leak-free operation
  • High temperature control accuracy with excellent temperature consistency
  • Comprehensive functional testing ensures product quality
  • Automated appearance finishing with high consistency

Services

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning, to after-sales service.
